//: Type-check config: the same compiler options as tsconfig.json, but with test/** in the program.
//why: tsconfig.json is src-only and vitest runs through esbuild (types erased, never checked), so without this second program this package's whole test/ tree gets ZERO type-checking — a fixture that drifted behind its interface stays latent until someone reads it. Added 2026-08-19; mirrors client/tsconfig.test.json. Run via `npm run typecheck:test` (CI: server-checks job, right after the `tsc -b` step).
//rootDir: Widened from src to the package root because test/ sits outside src/; composite/declaration off + noEmit because this program only reports diagnostics, it never emits.
//references: `references` MUST be repeated here — `extends` does NOT inherit it. Without it @nw/shared resolves through node_modules to shared/dist/*.d.ts instead of being redirected to shared/src, which showed up as 240 bogus TS2307s in metaserver alone. It still needs those dist/*.d.ts to exist, hence the CI ordering.
//module: ES2022 rather than the inherited CommonJS: vitest transpiles test files as ESM, and several e2e tests use top-level await, which is legal there but TS1378 under CommonJS.
//exclude: auction-fulllink.e2e.test.ts is left out of THIS program, not out of type-checking. It imports the real client WorldApiClient from client/src, which drags client sources -- DOM globals, pixi.js-legacy, @bufbuild/protobuf -- into the program; checking it here would mean installing client/node_modules in the server-checks CI job and adding lib:DOM to a Node-only config, i.e. bending this config into a second client config. It is instead owned by client/tsconfig.fulllink.json (`npm run typecheck:fulllink` in client/, chained into client's `npm run typecheck`), which runs in the CI job that already installs BOTH server/ and client/ deps. Added 2026-08-20; before that this really was the one unchecked server test file. scripts/checkWorkspaceCoverage.mjs now fails if anything listed here is missing from that program's include, so a new exclusion cannot quietly become an unchecked file.
